name: Planning Poker
goalName: Use 'planning poker' to get an estimated time on tasks
goal: Getting an estimated time immensely contributes to planning (hence planning poker). These times are useful to make a structured plan for the sprint or even the whole project. Planning poker is used as a tool for this.
normalLearnings: I am able to use planning poker as a tool to get an estimated time on tasks
I am more accurate in estimating a time for a task
result: The evidence is a screenshot of the planning poker. The result of which is an overview of how much time the whole implementation phase is going to take.<<image 11.png>>
validation: I performed planning poker with the group members.
contribution: Task division is next, after which we will start completing the tasks individually. Planning poker contributes in the structure and overall plan of the project.
